manifest.system_prompt: You are grading a market-data reading test. Use ONLY the provided context (text table/summary, chart image, rasterized text image, and/or markdown color key). When a color key is provided, the chart image has no text labels — map colors to tickers via the key. When the context is a rasterized text screenshot, read the monospace text in the image (same content as a text pack). Do not use outside knowledge of real tickers or prices — these series are synthetic. Follow the answer format in the question exactly. Be concise.

questions.prompt: Which ticker had the highest total return over the full sample? Reply with the ticker only.
Which ticker had the lowest (most negative) total return over the full sample? Reply with the ticker only.
Which ticker had the highest daily-return volatility (standard deviation)? Reply with the ticker only.
Which ticker had the second-highest daily-return volatility? Reply with the ticker only.
List the top 3 tickers by total return, best first. Reply as three tickers separated by commas.
List the top 5 tickers by total return, best first. Reply as five tickers separated by commas.
List the 3 worst tickers by total return, worst first. Reply as three tickers separated by commas.
On which date did PIBA reach its maximum closing price in the sample? Reply YYYY-MM-DD.
Did WEBA finish the sample above its starting close? Answer YES or NO.
Which ticker shows the sharpest single-day crash in the sample? Reply with the ticker only.
What was PIBA's total return over the sample in percent? Reply with a number only (no % sign).
How many tickers finished the sample with a positive total return? Reply with an integer only.
Among all 80 tickers sorted by total return (best first), which ticker sits at 0-based index 40 (the median rank)? Reply with the ticker only.
Which sector has the highest mean total return across its tickers? Reply with the sector name only (exact spelling from the data).
What was RIBA's total return over the sample in percent? Reply with a number only (no % sign).
What was RIBA's closing price on 2025-06-27? Reply with a number only.
